basic_profile.bio: An enthusiast of all things cosmic and digital, hailing from the outskirts of Seattle. I spend my days working as a software developer for a mid-sized tech company, and my nights exploring the vastness of modded Minecraft worlds. I'm particularly fascinated by the technical and creative challenges these mods present. When I'm not coding or gaming, you can find me at Dead & Company concerts or experimenting with new recipes in my kitchen. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings, often losing track of time as I dive deep into discussions. Currently single and enjoying the freedom to explore my interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in software development and modded gaming. I hold a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington, and I have been programming since my early teens. My experience with mods comes from years of playing Minecraft and experimenting with various mod packs, which has honed my understanding of game mechanics and scripting.
